evaluation_tasks.prompt: A developer built a client-rendered React SPA for an e-commerce store where products are fetched via `useEffect` on mount. When shared on Twitter or crawled by search bots, preview cards show blank content and meta tags are missing. Explain why and provide the solution.
pass_criteria: Explains that search bots and social crawlers (Twitter, LinkedIn, Slack) do not execute heavy client-side JavaScript when scraping meta tags.
Recommends migrating public marketing/product routes to Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or Static Site Generation (SSG) with Next.js/Astro.
Shows proper `<head>` tags: `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `<link rel="canonical">`, and `og:*` properties rendered in initial server HTML.
Includes absolute image URLs for `og:image` (1200x630 px).
fail_criteria: Suggests using client-side `useEffect` or `react-helmet` without SSR/prerendering.
Uses relative paths for Open Graph image tags.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: Design an analytics event tracking taxonomy plan for an onboarding flow (Landing -> Signup -> Onboarding -> Subscription Activated). Specify event names, properties, and privacy constraints.
pass_criteria: Strictly prohibits transmitting personal identifiable information (PII: plaintext emails, passwords, credit card numbers).
Coordinates with privacy consent manager before dispatching events.
fail_criteria: Includes raw user passwords or payment card details in event properties.
Uses erratic, unstructured event naming (e.g. mixing `click-button` with `UserSignedUp`).
